title: Test that legacy Git strings and bound copies keep sighting-based evidence rules
outcome: Add negative tests proving registered Git-input eligibility requires both a genuine registered producer and an unbound original evidence record.
acceptance: A grant-backed execution-observation check with a syntactically valid git-commit revision stays on the legacy sighting path, with refusal/no effects where the sighting prerequisite is unmet.
A cross-item verification_bind copy of a registered check stays on the legacy contract and cannot inherit the registered Git-input shortcut; refusal has no effects.

The tests would fail if either registered_git_basis guard (registered producer run_outcome presence or bound_from absence) were removed, without changing production eligibility or relabelling historical evidence.
